mapper.insert: INSERT INTO download_task (task_id, node_id, node_name, user_id, tenant_id, name, paths, status, total_size, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{nodeId}, #{nodeName}, #{userId}, #{tenantId}, #{name}, #{paths}, #{status}, #{totalSize}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE download_task SET status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM download_task ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
